items.title: Joe Segal — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And he formed a big band here for Chess Records... and Johnny Howell, the lead trumpeter, and a lot of great people.

ctx.x: And he formed a big band here for Chess Records, and had a picture of Chubby’s back leading the band, called “Chubby’s Back”. And he had Sandy Moss on tenor, and Lido Price, and Johnny Howell, the lead trumpeter, and a lot of great people.
